module: Member 3 - Data Engineering & Multi-Source Data Fusion

data_sources.name: Historical Rain Gauge Network
data_sources.description: Multi-year hourly precipitation observations across sub-basin monitoring stations.

data_sources.name: Software Rainfall Feed Simulator
data_sources.description: Simulated live precipitation feed representing intense cloudburst and storm surge events.

data_sources.name: Sub-surface Soil Moisture Sensors
data_sources.description: Volumetric soil water content (%) at 10cm depth across sub-basin zones.

data_sources.name: River Hydrological Gauging Station
data_sources.description: River stage level (cm), discharge rate (m3/s), and water rise acceleration.

data_sources.name: Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) Forecast
data_sources.description: Short-range ensemble precipitation forecast (1h, 3h, 6h, 12h horizon predictions).

data_sources.name: Historical Flood Events Registry
data_sources.description: Curated catalog of past basin flood events with peak stage, duration, damage labels, and ground truth flood classes.

data_sources.name: Community & Crowdsourced Ground Reports
data_sources.description: Citizen reports of waterlogging, bridge submergence, stream blockages, and localized hazards.
